raw.description:
GROW WITH US:
Tandem Diabetes Care creates new possibilities for people living with diabetes, their loved ones, and their healthcare providers through a positively different experience. We’d love for you to team up with us to “innovate every day,” put “people first,” and take the “no-shortcuts” approach that has propelled us to become a leader in the diabetes technology industry.

STAY AWESOME:
Tandem Diabetes Care is proud to manufacture and sell the Tandem Mobi system and t:slim X2 insulin pump with Control-IQ+ technology — an advanced predictive algorithm that automates insulin delivery. But we’re so much more than that. Our company’s human-centered approach to design, development, and support delivers innovative products and services for people who use insulin. Because many of our own team members live with diabetes, or have a loved one impacted by diabetes, the work is personal, and we are committed to the cause. Learn more at tandemdiabetes.com

A DAY IN THE LIFE:

The Senior Corporate Counsel reports to the Assistant General Counsel, Commercial and is responsible for providing legal support of the Company’s global contracts and commercial affairs. The Senior Corporate Counsel is also responsible for drafting, negotiating, and interpreting a broad range of company agreements and plays a key role in the development, management, and continuous improvement of the Company’s contract administration procedures.

The Sr CC role at Tandem is also responsible for;

  • Provides legal and business advice, drafting and negotiation expertise for a broad range of commercial and operational agreements, including non-disclosure, software, SaaS, services, consulting, marketing, material transfer, supply, manufacturing, equipment, leases, distribution, collaboration, partnership, development, and clinical trials.
  • Works directly with and advises key decision-makers in contract negotiations and other business arrangements, including identifying and proposing solutions to key business issues and managing risk. Provides legal advice regarding balancing risk.
  • Provides legal support for the Company’s expanding international operations, proactively identifies related business and legal risks, and collaborates cross-functionally to offer risk mitigation strategies and creative solutions.
  • Provides input in the development, and helps implement and administer, process improvements and systems for administration of key Legal department responsibilities.
  • Works closely with contract administrators to monitor contract covenants, expirations, and renewals monthly.
  • Continuously improves training and communications relating to relevant Legal department procedures.
  • Works cross functionally with other departments including members of regulatory, purchasing, R&D, finance, quality, IT, corporate and business development, and other departments to ensure a smooth and agile contracts life cycle process and to ensure consistency with Legal response times and compliance with laws and regulations.
  • Identifies, recommends, and implements internal controls for appropriate approvals of new contractual commitments and supports providing requested documents to our financial advisors and internal audit teams.
  • Manages outside counsel as needed.
  • Maintains the confidentiality of Legal Department communications and documentation.
  • Ensures contractual compliance with company policies, including privacy (HIPAA, CCPA, GDPR etc.) and other legal and regulatory requirements such as the EU/UK MDR and FDA regulations.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

  • Law degree (JD or equivalent) with excellent academic credentials and a license to practice in the state of California or licensed in another state and registered as In-House Counsel in California.
  • 10+ years of relevant legal experience with complex commercial transactions, preferably including at least 2 years of in-house experience with a medical device, pharmaceutical, or biotech company.
  • Significant experience with and breadth of knowledge related to contract law.
  • Familiarity with the federal False Claims Act, Anti-Kickback Statute, and Food Drug and Cosmetic Act.
  • Familiarity with general privacy law.
  • Working understanding of international, federal, and state rules and regulations applicable to medical device companies.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to operate independently and prioritize effectively while handling substantial and diverse work volume and serving as a key contributor for a rapidly growing organization.
  • High level of integrity supported by sound judgment and ethics.

WHEN & WHERE YOU’LL WORK:

Remote and/or Hybrid depending on candidate location and preferences; open to candidates within the United States. Equipment for the role will be provided and training will occur virtually.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:

The starting base pay range for this position is $225,000 - $250,000 annually. Base pay will vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience and may also fluctuate depending on candidate’s location and the overall job market. In addition to base pay, Tandem offers a competitive compensation package that includes bonus and a robust benefits package.

Tandem offers health care benefits such as medical, dental, vision available your first day, as well as health savings accounts and flexible saving accounts. You’ll also receive 11 paid holidays per year, unlimited PTO and you will have access to a 401k plan with company match as well as an Employee Stock Purchase plan. Learn more about Tandem’s benefits here!

YOU SHOULD KNOW:

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local Fair Chance laws and regulations. A conditional offer of employment from Tandem is contingent upon successful completion of a pre-employment screening process comprised of a drug test (excluding marijuana) and background check, which includes a review of criminal history information.

Tandem has good cause to conduct a review of criminal history information of candidates for this position, as this role may involve access to proprietary, sensitive and/or confidential information, including customer protected health information. This review is required to ensure that individuals in such roles uphold high standards of trust and integrity so as to protect the interests of our customers, employees, and stakeholders.

SPONSORSHIP:

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE:
At Tandem, we believe joy fuels excellence. That's why we've built a workplace that celebrates your achievements and supports your well-being. Our team thrives on pushing boundaries and fostering growth, all while maintaining a spirit of fun and camaraderie. This is just one of the ways we stay awesome! Explore the benefits and reasons to love Tandem at .

BE YOU, WITH US!

We embrace the value that every single one of us brings to the table. But sometimes we forget that when we don’t meet 100% of a job description’s criteria – maybe you’re feeling that way right now? We encourage you to apply anyway. Because we want you to be you, with us.

Tandem is firmly committed to being an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, sex, race, religion or belief, gender identity or expression, marriage/civil partnership, pregnancy/maternity, or sexual orientation. We are an inclusive organization, and we welcome applications from a wide range of candidates. Selection for roles will be based on individual merit alone.

REFERRALS:
We love a good referral! If you know someone who would be a great fit for this position, please share!

APPLICATION DEADLINE:
The position will be posted until a final candidate is selected for the requisition or the requisition has a sufficient number of applications.

Make a move that matters. Join Tandem Diabetes Care, where we're turning challenges into triumphs every day and where your talents will help shape a healthier, happier tomorrow.

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

  • Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.
  • Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.

If you want work with purpose, the agility to make an impact and a team that cares about the people behind the work as much as the work itself, we would love to hear from you.

About Cogstate

At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.

About the Clinician Network

By joining the Cogstate Clinician Network, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute your clinical expertise to research studies around the world.

Depending on your background, scales experience, and therapeutic area expertise, we may have an opportunity for you immediately - or it may take some time before a study opens that is the right fit.

Cogstate is continuing to grow and expand our clinical research initiatives, so new projects and opportunities are always on the horizon.

All applicants to the Clinician Network are kept in our active pipeline, and you’ll also receive our monthly Clinician Network newsletter, which shares updates and upcoming openings.

About the Role

Cogstate Clinicians are clinical psychologists or neuropsychologists responsible for delivering remote clinical interviews and cognitive assessment batteries to subjects with preclinical dementia, enrolled in a pharmaceutical clinical trial.

Cogstate provides all consultants with comprehensive, fully compensated training on general Cogstate operational policies, study-specific procedures, customized clinical interviewing skills and virtual cognitive assessment prior to performing remote scale administrations. Regular supervision and ongoing recalibration of clinical skill set will be provided.

*These are contract position.

*They are fully remote.

*Hired employee will work on an as needed basis based on their schedule.

- MADRS Administration Experience Required
- Lithuanian Fluency Required

Key Responsibilities

Central Rating

  • Remotely administering semi-structured clinical interview assessments and cognitive battery of tests to study subjects and caregivers.
  • Remotely delivering computerized and traditional cognitive assessments via a tele-health platform.
  • Scoring completed scale administrations.
  • Participating in regular clinical skill recalibration activities.

Central Monitoring

  • Providing reviews of completed neuropsychological test batteries for central monitoring of data to ensure accuracy in administration and scoring and contribute to the overall success of a clinical trial.
  • Reviewing response forms and recordings of remote scale administrations and offering feedback to raters via email and telephone communications.

Qualifications & Expertise

  • MD, DO, MBBS or PhD, PsyD in Psychology or RN, APRN, PA, MA/MS/MSW in Psychiatry (or equivalent)
  • Formal training in clinical interviewing and cognitive assessment
  • Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience with direct clinical interviewing and psychological assessment in clinical research industry, academic or clinical settings
  • Direct experience with cognitive/behavioral/functional assessment of neurological/psychiatric populations
  • Ability to meet deadlines, being highly organized and methodical, with attention to detail to ensure delivery
  • Proficiency with MS Office, including Word and Excel, email, teleconference platforms such as Skype, Zoom or other similar applications, and cloud-based storage service.
  • Lithuanian Fluency
  • MADRS Administration Experience Required

Our Culture
We bring our whole selves to work every day. We’re courageous and we deliver together. We’re passionate individuals who enjoy working together. We’re brave enough and care enough to have the right conversations to get the best outcome and are famous for our can-do attitude. We see challenges as opportunities and move with pace to achieve our goals.

If you’re ready to help us in our journey to optimize the measurement of brain health around the world, please apply now!

raw.excerpt: Career CategoryScientificJob DescriptionJoin Amgen’s Mission of Serving PatientsAt Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are.
raw.description:
Career Category

Scientific

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Scientist, Bioanalytical Sciences

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will serve as the technical subject matter expert for outsourced methods and is responsible to ensure adequate method validation and optimal method performance at CROs.

The Bioanalytical Scientist is responsible for oversight of the outsourced bioanalytical phases of studies governed by applicable GLP/GCP principles. Individuals in this role will provide scientific and technical oversight of bioanalytical activities (including pharmacokinetic [PK] and toxicokinetic [TK] analyses) performed by external contract research organizations (CROs), ensuring adherence to validated methods, data integrity standards, and alignment with study protocols and regulatory requirements. The ideal candidate will have a strong background of method development, validation, and troubleshooting in quantitative ligand-binding assays (LBA) and/or LC-MS bioanalysis, combined with excellent communication skills. This role is well suited for scientists who seek to learn more about externalized work and who thrive working with others in a collaborative manner.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provides scientific and technical oversight for the transfer, validation, and execution for pharmacokinetic (PK) assays, ensuring adherence to sponsor requirements and current regulatory guidance on bioanalytical assays (e.g. FDA, ICH, EMEA, NMPA)
  • Leads the transfer and validation of PK assays at external CROs using ligand-binding, ELISA, ECL, LC-MS/MS and hybrid methodologies
  • Collaborates closely with internal bioanalytical subject matter experts to understand critical attributes of the PK method to ensure successful assay transfer and validation
  • Monitors assay performance over time and provides input for troubleshooting and continuous improvement efforts
  • Accountable for method lifecycle management, including review of method validation plans, protocols, reports, and qualification/bridging of reagents and reference material
  • Reviews analytical data, method protocol, validation/sample analysis plans, reports, and other study documentation for scientific accuracy and consistency with GLP/GCP documentation standards and current regulatory guidance
  • Works with cross functional partners from CROs to navigate issue resolution and escalation utilizing the governance structure
  • Provides subject matter expertise during supplier evaluation and monitoring activities
  • Follows and contributes to guidance documents and SOPs
  • Supports regulatory activities

What expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The dynamic professional we seek is a leader with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:

Doctorate degree [and relevant post-doc where applicable]

OR

Master’s degree and 2 years of regulated commercial scientific laboratory experience

OR

Bachelor’s degree and 4 years of regulated commercial scientific laboratory experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated expertise in PK assay development, validation, and troubleshooting for LBA, LC-MS or hybrid assays
  • Knowledgeable on current relevant regulatory guidance/regulations (e.g. FDA, ICH, EMEA, NMPA)
  • Experienced in working with CROs
  • Project and people management
  • Process management and planning skills

Our client is an international education consultancy that helps students pursue medical and dental education opportunities abroad. They support prospective students throughout the decision-making and admissions journey, working closely with academic institutions and internal admissions teams to provide guidance on programs, applications, and relocation. The company operates as a fully remote, collaborative team with a fast-paced and entrepreneurial culture.

Description:
Our client is seeking a Sales Lead to manage inbound prospective students and families throughout the full consultation and enrolment process. This role is focused on understanding each student's academic goals, advising them on appropriate educational pathways, maintaining a strong sales pipeline, and converting qualified prospects into enrolled students.

The ideal candidate will have previous experience selling education-related services directly to students or parents and will be comfortable independently managing a high-volume pipeline in a remote, fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage inbound leads and conduct consultations with prospective students and parents
  • Understand each student's academic goals and recommend appropriate medical or dental education pathways
  • Manage prospects throughout the full sales cycle, from initial consultation through negotiation and enrolment
  • Maintain an accurate sales pipeline and forecast expected enrolments
  • Follow up with prospective students through WhatsApp, email, phone, and other communication channels
  • Negotiate with students and parents and close qualified prospects into the program
  • Maintain accurate prospect information and activity within the CRM
  • Support and oversee email campaigns targeting prospective students
  • Coordinate with internal teams to maintain accurate information regarding academic programs and partner institutions
  • Keep program and institutional information updated within internal knowledge-management systems
  • Independently qualify leads and prioritize opportunities based on likelihood to enrol
  • Collaborate closely with the wider sales, admissions, and administrative teams
  • Travel up to twice per year to meet university partners and support groups of students during relocation

Qualifications:

Required:

  • Minimum 1 year of directly relevant education sales, student recruitment, admissions, or education consulting experience
  • Experience selling services directly to students and/or parents
  • Proven experience managing prospects through a full sales process and closing business
  • Experience managing a sales pipeline, forecasting, follow-ups, and multiple active opportunities simultaneously
  • Comfortable working independently and managing responsibilities in a fully remote environment
  • Experience using remote collaboration tools such as Google Drive, Google Sheets, Slack, or similar platforms
  • Experience using CRM systems and strong general computer skills
  • Fluent English
  • Minimum high school education
  • Availability to work UK business hours

Preferred:

  • University degree
  • Previous experience working within a startup or fast-growing organization
  • Experience in international education, student recruitment, admissions consulting, or study-abroad services
  • Experience independently managing a high-volume inbound sales pipeline
  • Proven ability to consistently meet or exceed enrolment or sales targets

Why Join Us?

  • Join a fast-paced, collaborative, entrepreneurial, fully remote international team with significant autonomy
  • Earn commission based on performance, including 10% on qualifying revenue above the previous year's revenue benchmark
  • Receive medical benefits and 28 days of annual leave
  • Take ownership of the full sales process from consultation through enrolment
  • Work directly with students and families making important educational decisions
  • Opportunity to progress into a Sales Manager position with an associated salary increase

We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Why this role is on the menu

We are looking for a seasoned Oracle Fusion ERP Technical Analyst to join our Financial Systems team and accelerate a portfolio of Order-to-Cash (O2C), Record-to-Report (R2R) and Procure to Pay (P2P) transformation initiatives. In this role you will own the design, development, and delivery of custom reports, data integration interfaces, document templates, and REST/SOAP API solutions within Oracle Fusion Cloud — enabling finance and cross-functional stakeholders to operate with greater speed and accuracy.

The Financial Systems team owns the technology backbone for Instacart's finance operations, managing Oracle Fusion, Zip, Billing Platform, OIC, HighRadius, Workiva, and FloQast. We partner closely with Finance, Platform Engineering, and the CTO organization to drive transformation initiatives that scale with the business. You'll work on meaningful projects, see your contributions in production quickly, and have a direct line to executive stakeholders.

What you'll cook up in your first year

Reporting & Analytics

  • Finance reporting requirements are met through a production-ready Oracle BIP library: data models, RTF templates, and scheduled bursting jobs are built and maintained, and parameterized BIP reports are exposed as REST endpoints for programmatic access by external systems and dashboards.
  • Business Intelligence Cloud Connector (BICC) extracts are configured and maintained for data warehouse integration and downstream analytics, giving finance stakeholders scalable, reusable access to financial data.

Document Customization

  • External-facing document templates, including Invoices, Credit Memos, Statements, and Purchase Orders, are designed and customized using RTF and XML Publisher, with corporate branding, conditional logic, and dynamic data sections applied to meet audit and customer experience standards.
  • Sub-templates and style templates are built and maintained to enforce consistent formatting across the full document library, reducing one-off customization work.

Data Integration & FBDI

  • File-Based Data Import (FBDI) templates and automation scripts are production-ready for bulk data loads across AR, AP, GL, and other Fusion modules, and inbound/outbound interface files (CSV, XML, JSON) are built and maintained for integrations with billing platforms, collections tools, and third-party financial applications, with load errors troubleshot, data mappings validated, and interface specs documented.

API & Systems Integration

  • REST and SOAP API integrations are live between Oracle Fusion and systems including Billing Platform, HighRadius, Workiva, and FloQast, designed and implemented using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) and BIP-generated endpoints, with reusable integration patterns for inbound and outbound data flows aligned to CTO org architecture and API governance standards.

Transformation Project Support

  • O2C, R2R, and P2P transformation workstreams have clear technical specifications, with solutions documented in Confluence, development tasks tracked in Jira, and accurate status updates delivered to executive stakeholders through steerco and roadmap planning cycles.

The secret ingredients we're looking for

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

  • 5+ years of hands-on Oracle Fusion Cloud technical development experience.
  • Deep expertise in Oracle BIP: data models, RTF templates, XML Publisher, parameter-driven reports, and bursting.
  • Proven experience building FBDI templates across multiple Fusion modules (AR, AP, GL, FA, or similar).
  • Strong BICC configuration and data extraction experience for analytics and data warehouse use cases.
  • Experience designing and customizing Oracle Fusion invoice templates and other external-facing transactional documents using RTF and XML.
  • Proficiency with XML, XSLT, and XPath for document and data transformation.
  • Hands-on experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) or equivalent middleware for REST/SOAP API development.
  • Strong written communication skills — comfortable producing technical specs, interface docs, and steerco-ready summaries.

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Oracle Fusion Cloud certification (Technical or Financials track).
  • Experience integrating Oracle Fusion with Workday, HighRadius, Workiva, FloQast, or billing/collections platforms.
  • Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks and solution design documentation.
  • Exposure to BI Catalog management and OTBI reporting.
  • Experience with Oracle Smart View for Office for ad-hoc financial analysis and reporting.
  • Knowledge of Oracle Financial Reporting Studio (FRS) for building formatted financial statements.
  • Familiarity with Financial Data Integration (FDI) for managing data load rules, mappings, and data management workflows (nice to have).
  • Exposure to Oracle Visual Builder Cloud Service (VBCS) for building lightweight web UIs or extending Oracle Fusion applications.
  • Experience in a high-growth, fast-paced technology company.
  • Prior involvement in large-scale ERP transformation, module implementation, or re-platforming projects.

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

Job Title: SAP System Administrator
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary

We are seeking a seasoned SAP System Administrator responsible for the architecture, installation, configuration, performance tuning, and day-to-day operation of complex SAP landscapes that may span on-premises, hybrid, and cloud-hosted environments. This role is critical to keeping mission-critical SAP systems available, performant, secure, and compliant. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise across SAP NetWeaver, S/4HANA, HANA database administration, system copies, upgrades, and migrations, and will partner with infrastructure, security, and SAP functional teams to deliver a stable, well-governed SAP platform.



Key Responsibilities
  • Architect, install, configure, and operate SAP landscapes including S/4HANA, ECC, BW/4HANA, Solution Manager, and other NetWeaver-based systems across on-prem and cloud environments.
  • Administer SAP HANA databases — including installation, sizing, replication, backup, recovery, and performance tuning — to meet demanding availability and performance SLAs.
  • Plan and execute SAP system copies, refreshes, and post-copy automation activities to support development, testing, training, and migration scenarios.
  • Lead SAP upgrades, EHP installations, Support Package application, kernel upgrades, and S/4HANA conversions with minimal disruption to business operations.
  • Design and implement SAP migrations to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and SAP RISE/Grow environments, including network and identity integration.
  • Configure and operate high-availability and disaster-recovery solutions for SAP, including HANA System Replication, cluster-based failover, and validated DR runbooks.
  • Implement and maintain SAP transport management strategies, including Solution Manager ChaRM and CTS+ workflows.
  • Manage SAP user provisioning, role management, and audit support in close collaboration with the SAP Security/GRC team.
  • Monitor SAP system performance, capacity, and health using Solution Manager, Focused Run, native HANA tools, and external APM platforms.
  • Develop automation scripts and runbooks using Ansible, PowerShell, or Python to reduce operational toil and accelerate routine tasks.
  • Manage and remediate SAP security notes, kernel patches, and database patches in accordance with internal security and compliance policies.
  • Provide 24x7 on-call support for production SAP systems and lead structured incident response and post-incident reviews.
  • Document SAP architecture, operations procedures, and standard operating processes to support knowledge sharing and team scalability.
  • Mentor junior Basis engineers and contribute to the broader SAP platform roadmap.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of SAP Basis / platform engineering experience in large enterprise environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience administering SAP HANA databases in production.
  • Experience operating S/4HANA, ECC, BW/4HANA, Solution Manager, and other NetWeaver systems.
  • Hands-on experience with SAP migrations to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Strong experience with SAP upgrades, EHP/SP application, and system conversions.
  • Solid experience with SAP HA/DR strategies, including HANA System Replication and clustering.
  • Working knowledge of SAP transport management and Solution Manager ChaRM.
  • Scripting skills in Bash, PowerShell, Python, or Ansible.
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications
  • SAP certifications in HANA, S/4HANA, or Basis administration.
  • Experience with SAP RISE / Grow and SAP Cloud ALM.
  • Familiarity with SAP BTP and integration with hyperscaler-native services.
  • Exposure to infrastructure-as-code for SAP landscapes (Ansible, Terraform).
  • Experience operating regulated SAP workloads (SOX, GxP, PCI).

Job Description

The Senior Analyst, Data & Analystcs, supports the out-of-network (OON) provider liability operating model by developing the analytics, reporting, and market intelligence needed to inform the negotiation strategy, arbitration positioning, QPA payment accuracy, and overall IDR performance. The role reports to the Manager, Provider Dispute Strategy, and serves as the primary analytics partner for pre-IDR negotiation, federal NSA IDR, state-based dispute processes, and provider-level OON liability management. The Senior Analyst is responsible for integrating data from multiple internal and external sources, building reporting dashboards, producing actionable insights, and translating financial and operational data into recommendations that support improved dispute outcomes. This role requires strong data management, healthcare finance, reimbursement, and reporting capabilities, as well as the ability to connect claim-level detail, dispute outcomes, provider behavior, QPA performance, market benchmarks, and financial reporting trends. The role partners with stakeholders to define requirements, develop scalable reporting and data processes, and apply advanced analytical techniques to identify trends, forecast outcomes, and drive business performance.

Job Duties

  • Analyzes complex datasets from multiple sources to identify trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities. Tracks performance across pre-IDR negotiation, open negotiation, arbitration, settlement, and post-award outcomes.
    • Designs, develop, and maintain reports, dashboards, and data solutions using tools such as Structured Query Language (SQL), Microsoft Excel, and SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS). Produces standard and ad hoc reporting for Manager, Network Strategy, Finance, Operations and health plan stakeholders.
    • Translates business needs into reporting and analytical requirements; partner with stakeholders to deliver actionable insights. Combines data from multiple internal and external sources, including claims, QPA data, IDR case tracking, negotiation records, provider data, financial reporting, market benchmarks, and third-part data sources.
    • Performs healthcare data analysis, including claims, utilization, and cost data. Leverages external data sources as well to inform trends.
    • Develops and maintains data processes for extraction, transformation, validation, and integration.
    • Ensures data accuracy, integrity, and consistency through quality assurance and validation processes. Reconciles data across systems and identifies gaps, inconsistencies, and quality issues.
    • Partners with IT, Finance, Medical Economics, Actuary and Operations / Shared Services and external vendors to improve data availability and reporting automation, specifically collaborating with the provider dispute intake team
    • Produces and monitors key performance metrics, including: Percent of cases settled pre-IDR, averaged negotiated rate versus initial offer, percent of negotiations escalated to IDR, provider acceptance rate, IDR award versus QPA, IDR win rate, win rate by arbitrator, etc. Supports target-setting and performance management of dispute-related KPIs; establishes reporting views by market, state, provider, specialty, and arbitrator.
    • Develops financial views that quantifies dispute exposure, settlement impact, arbitration outcomes and avoided cost; translates financial reporting outputs into actionable insights for negotiation strategy and health plan playbooks
    • Develops visual dashboards that summarize OON dispute performance, financial impact, and strategic opportunities; creates executive-ready reporting materials for leadership reviews and governance forums; develops drill-down capability from enterprise-level performance to market, provider, specialty and case-level detail
    • Presents findings and recommendations to leadership and cross-functional teams.

Job Qualifications

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Economics, Math, Business Administration, Information Systems or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
    • At least 4 years of experience in data analysis, reporting, or analytics, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
    • Strong experience with Structured Query Language (SQL), relational databases, and Microsoft Excel.
    • Experience with reporting and visualization tools (e.g., SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) or similar).
    • Experience working with complex datasets, including claims, provider, reimbursement, and financial data
    • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver on deadlines
    • Advanced data analysis and critical thinking, with experience developing dashboards, scorecards, recurring reports, and executive-facing analytics

• Data quality & governance

  • Stakeholder communication & influence, with ability to translate detailed data into clear business insights and recommendations
    • Proficiency with data visualization and analytics tools, such as Tableau, Power BI, or other similar platforms

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience with No Surprises Act IDR, state-based provider dispute processes, OON claims, or provider payment disputes
    • Knowledge of QPA methodology, provider reimbursement, Medicare-based pricing, commercial benchmarks, or payer claims adjudication
    • Experience combining internal data with external market data sources
  • Advanced SQL, Python R, or Alteryx skills
    • Experience with financial reporting, medical cost reporting, or healthcare P&L analysis
    • Experience supporting provider contracting, network strategy, medical economics, or payment integrity teams

  • Follow established SOPs, QA checklists, and templates for media buying and stewardship, and contribute ideas to improve them over time.
  • Help maintain and improve trackers and tools used for buys, pacing, and reporting to ensure alignment between vendor documentation, internal systems, and client reporting.

raw.companyName: Codest Ltd. Company No. 12590542, VAT number: GB363431020
raw.description:
🌍 Hello World!

We are The Codest - International Tech Software Company with tech hubs in Poland delivering global IT solutions and projects. Our core values lie in “Customers and People First” approach that prioritises the needs of our customers and a collaborative environment for our employees, enabling us to deliver exceptional products and services.

Our expertise centers on web development, cloud engineering, DevOps and quality. After many years of developing our own product - Yieldbird, which was honored as a laureate of the prestigious Top25 Deloitte awards, we arrived at our mission: to help tech companies build impactful product and scale their IT teams through boosting IT delivery performance. Through our extensive experience with product development challenges, we have become experts in building digital products and scaling IT teams.

But our journey does not end here - we want to continue our growth. If you’re goal-driven and looking for new opportunities, join our team! What awaits you is an enriching and collaborative environment that fosters your growth at every step.

💡 The project:

We are looking for an experienced Senior Platform Engineer (full-time or part-time).

Own the production system end-to-end. Today the entire stack runs self-hosted on Docker Compose: a custom-built lighttpd with database-driven virtual hosts, MariaDB, a Kubo IPFS node, Dozzle for logs, and Uptime Kuma for monitoring. There is no CI/CD pipeline, no infrastructure-as-code, no application performance monitoring, and the scaling story is vertical for now. Your job is to keep the lights on, automate the manual work, design how this system scales, and make pragmatic build-vs-buy decisions on cloud services (load balancing, object storage, managed databases) as we grow.

Requirements

📈 Responsibilities:

  • Operate the production system: deploys, rollbacks, capacity, incident response.

  • Design and execute the scaling roadmap — horizontal scaling, load balancing, caching layers, object-storage offload, database replication, IPFS-node fan-out.

  • Evaluate and integrate cloud building blocks (managed databases, object storage, CDN, load balancers) where they earn their cost.

  • Stand up CI/CD pipelines (greenfield — likely GitHub Actions) covering test, build, image push, and deploy across all services.

  • Establish observability: metrics, logs, error tracking, SLOs, and meaningful alerts.

  • Manage TLS / ACME automation, DNS, and secrets handling — replace today's hardcoded credentials with a proper secret-management story.

  • Introduce infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or comparable) so the production system is reproducible.

  • Use AI coding assistants to author IaC modules, runbooks, and incident-response playbooks.

🔑 Tech Stack You'll Work With or Introduce:

  • Docker, Docker Compose, image building.

  • Linux (Debian-style), Bash, Python for scripting.

  • Lighttpd today (niche, with DB-driven vhost logic you'll learn) - likely to be reconsidered as we scale.

  • MariaDB - including replication, backup/restore drills, performance tuning.

  • Kubo IPFS node, private-swarm operation, gateway scaling.

  • Let's Encrypt / ACME / Certbot.

  • Load-balancing layer (to be chosen - HAProxy, Caddy, NGINX, ALB/NLB, etc.).

  • Object storage (to be chosen - S3, GCS, R2, MinIO; mainly for non-IPFS payloads and backups).

  • CI/CD (likely GitHub Actions, to be confirmed).

  • Observability stack (likely Prometheus + Grafana + Loki + Sentry - to be introduced).

  • IaC: Terraform or Ansible (to be introduced).

  • One of AWS / GCP / Azure as the long-term cloud target - tbd

Hard Skills - Must-Have:

  • 5+ years professional Linux sysadmin / DevOps / SRE / Platform Engineering.

  • Docker fluency: writing, debugging, and optimizing Dockerfiles and multi-service compose stacks.

  • Networking fundamentals: DNS, TLS, HTTP semantics, reverse proxies, load balancers.

  • Scripting: Bash plus at least one of Python (or similar like Go/Ruby).

  • Hands-on CI/CD pipeline design with any modern system.

  • Production operations experience - you have been on-call, you have written postmortems, you have designed a capacity plan.

  • Familiarity with at least one major cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure) including its load-balancing, object-storage, and managed-database primitives.

  • Git fluency.

  • Experience using AI coding assistants and agent-based workflows in real ops work.

  • Strong written English - runbooks, RFCs, and postmortems are core deliverables.

Hard Skills - Nice-to-Have:

  • Kubernetes operational experience (CKA welcome but not required).

  • Terraform or Ansible at intermediate-or-deeper depth.

  • Multi-cloud literacy — you have shipped on more than one of AWS, GCP, Azure.

  • Observability stacks: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, OpenTelemetry, Sentry.

  • Database operations beyond CRUD: replication, point-in-time recovery, query tuning.

  • IPFS or other content-addressable / peer-to-peer storage operational experience.

  • Security hardening - OWASP, basic pen-testing literacy, secrets-management tooling (Vault, SOPS, AWS SM).

  • Cost engineering - you have right-sized a cloud bill before.

  • Cloud or Kubernetes certifications.

Soft Skills:

  • Calm under outages - you reach for tail -f before you reach for blame.

  • Pragmatism: you can tell when introducing Kubernetes is correct and when it is yak-shaving.

  • Documentation discipline - if it isn't in a runbook, it doesn't exist.

  • Comfortable saying "no" or "not yet" to premature complexity.

📜 Our offer:

  • Salary: 30-33k on B2B

  • 100% remote work (full-time or part-time)

  • A unique opportunity to take your career to the next level - we’re looking for people who want to create an impact. You have ideas, we want to hear them!

📌Recruitment process:

  • 30 minute screening call online with our recruiter, Justyna

  • Interview with CTO

  • 1h technical interview

  • Interview with CEO

  • Offer

Questions, insights? Feel free to reach out to our recruiting team:

In the meantime, feel free to visit our website where you can find key facts about us.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within KIRA's AI Finance.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser, and Pocket, a service for keeping up with the best content online. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders - only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

We’re looking for a hands-on Mobile Product Manager with a primary focus on Firefox for iOS, while also contributing across mobile (including Android).

This role is about building a better browser, turning downloads into loyal users, and creating experiences that truly stand out. If you’ve shipped mobile apps, obsess over details that improve everyday use, and love turning user insights into real improvements, this is a great opportunity to drive impact at Firefox.

What you’ll do:

  • Build a fundamentally better browser experience: fix bugs, refine UI and navigation, improve downloads, menus, performance, and all the small details that make Firefox noticeably better for users who care about privacy, quality and reliability.
  • Drive strong activation and retention: focus on the new-user journey, quickly hooking people after they install the app, understanding where they drop off, and relentlessly optimizing the funnel through data, testing and iteration.

  • Mobile & Browser Fluency: Deep understanding of iOS (and ideally Android) ecosystems, app store policies and web browser technologies, with genuine passion for what makes a great browsing experience.

  • User Obsession: Natural habit of studying apps, following trends on platforms like X/Twitter and Reddit, and testing experiences yourself to uncover opportunities.
  • Global & Growth Mindset: Interest or experience growing products in international markets with sensitivity to local user needs.

  • Experience providing psychotherapy in outpatient, private practice, or telehealth settings

  • Ability to work independently in a remote setting with professionalism and integrity

The Benefits of Joining Affect

raw.description:
Corteva Agriscience is looking for an SAP Finance-Treasury Solution Engineer (SE) to be part of the Integrated Enterprise Solutions team. The ideal candidate will have recent experience conceptualizing, designing, implementing, and supporting SAP Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR) and Treasury solutions. The SE will be responsible for engineering, configuring, testing, and maintaining SAP S/4HANA and surrounding AP, AR, Treasury, Cash flow, In-house cash, and hedging solutions throughout the application lifecycle.

The role requires strong knowledge of business processes within SAP S/4 Payables, Receivables and Treasury overall, as well as other non-SAP Treasury and financial systems. This position defines and drives the strategy for putting the engineering elements in place to support Corteva’s vision for Treasury, Banking processes and in-general, all Financials flows with external partners and related IT systems in the medium to long term. It involves discovering, validating, and mapping relevant business functions through interviews, research, industry trends, and developments, and leveraging them for modeling, prototyping, simulating, and analyzing current and future states using SAP and non-SAP solutions for Treasury, AP & AR to provide robust, scalable solutions.

The SE must be able to bridge the IT and business domains and effectively communicate with other Solution Engineers, Business Process Experts, configurators, and Solution Architects within Corteva IT to develop a consistent end-to-end solution supporting financial flows within Corteva and with external partners. The SE will thoroughly understand the Corteva Agriscience business strategy and processes for Treasury, AP & AR to help define and execute the overall ERP Finance Product Roadmap.

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities

  • SAP Solution Engineer for S/4HANA global solution spanning multiple countries over North America, Europe, LATAM, and Asia-Pacific for Treasury, AP & AR.
  • Exhibits good command of more than one of the following areas in SAP Treasury: Cash Management, In-House Cash, Payments, Multi-Bank Connectivity, Trading Platform Integration, short- and long-term investments and debt instruments, credit risk and market data management, and loan management (FS-CML).
  • Understands business processes and non-SAP applications integration related to Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR) processes.
  • Understands business processes related to financial instrument hedging, such as intercompany loans and derivatives (e.g., FX options and FX forwards) or commodities hedging.
  • Translates and maps business processes to enable design in SAP AP, AR, TRM, hedging, and surrounding applications. Helps identify end-to-end functional and non-functional system requirements, including integration with other non-SAP tools and systems surrounding the S/4 platform.
  • Has hands-on ability to independently prototype SAP solutions to meet end-to-end Treasury, AP and AR requirements, or define a work breakdown structure for a configuration and development team to develop a cohesive working solution.
  • Is able to engineer SAP AP, AR and TRM configuration and enhancements for a robust, scalable solution.
  • Researches current trends and best practices to advise business leads and IT configurators on the best solution approach for Corteva.
  • Has hands-on ability to write system design documents, including detailed design and technical design, update requirements traceability, and develop test scenarios and cases.
  • Envisions critical scenarios and points of failure in the end-to-end process and defines relevant test cases. Performs end-to-end functional and non-functional testing of the system to meet requirements, including unit testing, SIT, UAT, regression testing, and performance testing.
  • Can identify and define process and system dependencies while implementing new SAP functionality in the context of ongoing enterprise business and IT initiatives.
  • Can understand requirements, perform fit-gap analysis, provide estimates, and suggest process and technology improvements.
  • Works with Run & Maintain service providers to manages the periodic SAP and non-SAP upgrades through evaluation, regression testing, and deployment.
  • Provides guidance with SAP-Security role design.
  • Owns the performance aspect of end-to-end SAP Treasury, AP & AR service delivery in Production.
  • Preferably has experience with SWIFT integration services, ISO 20022, and non-SAP Supply Chain Finance solutions.
  • Preferred solution design experience demonstrating an understanding of various Treasury business process designs and SAP integration experience with SAP and third-party platforms such as Serrala, Taulia, SAP-CCP, SAP Digital Payments (EBPP), FIS, 360T, IT2, and Bloomberg.

Qualifications

Position Requirements

  • Prior domain or functional experience with Treasury and Finance functions in large companies.
  • Understands how derivatives work in SAP, using FX options or FX forwards as underlying instruments. Experience with commodities futures, margin payments, or options instruments would be useful.
  • Ability to research requirements and solutions, evaluate alternative approaches, and present a recommended solution in SAP or similar Treasury systems.
  • Ability to work in a high-pressure project environment with speed and agility.
  • Strong attention to detail and quality/accuracy of deliverables, preferring outcomes over outputs.
  • Demonstrated effectiveness and ability to work independently, and drive results with peers, stakeholders, and customers.
  • Acts honestly and professionally, with the ability to handle highly confidential and time-sensitive information.
  • Ability to prioritize and multitask under minimal supervision.
  • Decisive ability to recognize when to act and when to escalate.
  • Demonstrable accumulated knowledge of Treasury processes in a global environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience working with large vendor partners, suppliers, and third-party contractors preferred.

Experience and Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Treasury, or a related field. CPA, CFA, or an equivalent advanced degree preferred.
  • The ideal candidate will have experience in the Oil & Gas, Utilities, or Financial Services industries implementing and supporting SAP Finance and Treasury.

Benefits – How We’ll Support You:

  • Numerous development opportunities offered to build your skills

  • Be part of a company with a higher purpose and contribute to making the world a better place

  • Health benefits for you and your family on your first day of employment

  • Four weeks of paid time off and two weeks of well-being pay per year, plus paid holidays

  • Excellent parental leave which includes a minimum of 16 weeks for mother and father

  • Future planning with our competitive retirement savings plan and tuition reimbursement program

  • Learn more about our total rewards package here - Corteva Benefits

  • Check out life at Corteva!

Are you a good match? Apply today! We seek applicants from all backgrounds to ensure we get the best, most creative talent on our team.

Corteva Agriscience is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to embracing our differences to enrich lives, advance innovation, and boost company performance. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, military or veteran status, pregnancy related conditions (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), disability or any other protected status in accordance with federal, state, or local laws.

description: About TQATQA is the Agentic AI Experts.  We turn Agentic AI into real-world advantage, transforming how enterprises operate, adapt, and outperform.

raw.title: Engagement Lead, Finance and Accounting
raw.excerpt: About TQATQA is the Agentic AI Experts.  We turn Agentic AI into real-world advantage, transforming how enterprises operate, adapt, and outperform.
raw.description:
About TQA

TQA is the Agentic AI Experts. We turn Agentic AI into real-world advantage, transforming how enterprises operate, adapt, and outperform. We deliver agentic and automation solutions that work in production rather than in a laboratory, built across Microsoft, UiPath, and ServiceNow, with the integration expertise to connect legacy, cloud, and new platforms. We stay with our clients from vision through to measurable value.

Better. Faster. Proven.

Our values guide how we work: Be Human, Every Day. Always Moving Forward. Future Focused. A Trusted Partner.

About the Role

We are hiring a senior finance and accounting leader to become the domain authority on a major agentic AI and automation program inside a global marketing services group. You will not run a ledger. You will sit alongside the client’s transformation and controllership leadership, find the finance processes where agents and automation create genuine P&L value, prove the case in numbers, and keep a validated pipeline ahead of a multi-country delivery team. This is a client advisory role first and a delivery role second.

Our client is a publicly traded, digital-first global marketing network: more than 50 agency partners, over 13,000 specialists, operations across 40 countries, and revenue of approximately $2.9 billion. That federated structure produces finance and accounting complexity at scale. Many legal entities and ledgers, high-volume intercompany activity, project and job-level accounting, pass-through and media billing, and a monthly close that spans multiple agencies, currencies, and jurisdictions.

TQA has delivered automation for this client for more than nine months. The program is now moving from opportunistic quick wins to a curated, value-led pipeline delivered through dedicated pods. The constraint is finance domain judgment at the top of the funnel. The client’s transformation leadership cannot be in every finance conversation, so opportunities go unqualified and skilled delivery capacity waits on work that has not been validated or standardized.

This role closes that gap. You become the finance and accounting voice inside the program: the person in the room when agency and shared services teams talk about how work actually gets done, the person who recognizes where an agent beats a rule-based robot, and the person who hands delivery a backlog that is quantified, standardized, and ready to build.

Key Responsibilities

Advise the client, proactively

  • Act as the trusted finance and accounting advisor to the client’s transformation, controllership, and shared services leadership. Bring a point of view rather than waiting for a brief.

  • Represent the automation and AI agenda in agency and functional meetings where the client’s transformation team cannot be present. Act as their proxy and their advocate.

  • Challenge process design before automating it. Recommend standardization, control improvement, or retirement so that the program automates a good process rather than an efficient bad one.

  • Build relationships across the agency network so that finance leaders bring opportunities to you directly.

Own the pipeline and the value case

  • Identify, qualify, size, and sequence candidate processes across record to report, order to cash, purchase to pay, close and consolidation, intercompany, and management reporting.

  • Quantify each candidate: current effort and cost, target state, expected benefit, control impact, and payback. Present it in language a CFO organization accepts.

  • Keep a validated backlog running ahead of delivery capacity so that architects, analysts, and developers are never waiting on undefined work.

  • Decide, with the client, what to automate now, what to standardize first, and where an agentic solution is the right answer rather than traditional automation.

Shape solutions and assure delivery

  • Partner with solution architects and business analysts to turn finance process knowledge into agentic and automation designs on UiPath, Microsoft, and ServiceNow.

  • Set acceptance criteria that finance and audit will sign off, covering segregation of duties, evidence retention, auditability, and control impact in a public company environment.

  • Chair value readouts with client leadership. Connect delivered work to measured financial outcome rather than activity completed.

  • Support hypercare, knowledge transfer, and handover so that benefits persist after go-live.

Grow the account and the practice

  • Identify and shape adjacent opportunities, for example internal audit and controls testing, HR operations, and managed service, and work with the account team to bring them forward.

  • Feed reusable finance patterns, benchmarks, and accelerators back into TQA’s industry solutions library.

  • Coach TQA and client colleagues on finance domain context so that the whole pod raises its own commercial judgment.

How we will measure success

In the first 90 days

  • Client transformation and finance leadership treat you as a trusted advisor and invite you into conversations by name.

  • A documented finance and accounting process landscape exists, with each process rated for automation and agentic potential.

  • A qualified, sized, and sequenced pipeline covers at least the next two delivery quarters.

Within 12 months

  • A live value ledger links delivered automation and agents to quantified financial benefit, accepted by the client finance organization.

  • Measurable improvement in close cycle time, manual effort, or control exceptions across the processes in scope.

  • Pipeline coverage stays consistently ahead of delivery capacity.

  • At least one adjacent workstream opens as a direct result of your advisory relationship.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Twelve or more years in finance and accounting, including significant time in controllership, financial operations, shared services, or finance transformation leadership. A qualified accountant background is strongly preferred, for example CPA, CMA, ACA, ACCA, or CIMA.

  • Deep, hands-on process knowledge across the finance lifecycle: month-end close and consolidation, intercompany, order to cash and collections, purchase to pay, expense and vendor management, and management reporting.

  • Demonstrated delivery of finance transformation using automation, AI, or agentic solutions, with benefits you can describe and defend in numbers.

  • A track record of client-facing or business partnering work at CFO, controller, and vice president level. You are comfortable being the most senior finance voice in the room.

  • Proven ability to build business cases and value models that finance leaders accept and finance teams can verify.

  • Experience inside a complex multi-entity, multi-currency environment, ideally with shared services or global business services exposure.

  • Based in the United States with the right to work in the United States, and willing to travel to client sites occasionally.

Nice to Have

  • Finance leadership inside a marketing, advertising, media, or professional services business. Lieu du mandat :
Télétravail – la ressource doit être basée au Québec

Langue requise :

Français obligatoire

Heures de travail par semaine :

35 heures

Durée de la mission :

12 mois

Particularités :

  • CV en français
  • Diplôme reconnu par le MÉLS ou équivalence du MIFI requise
  • Expérience dans le secteur public/parapublic fortement pertinente
  • Expérience dans le secteur de la santé ou des services sociaux considérée comme un atout

À propos du poste

Nous recherchons un(e) Analyste d’affaires TI afin de contribuer à la préparation, au cadrage et à l’analyse de projets technologiques dans le secteur de la santé et des services sociaux.

La personne accompagnera les demandeurs dans la clarification de leurs besoins et participera activement à la préparation des dossiers d’opportunité (DO) et des dossiers d’affaires (DA). Elle assurera également la coordination entre les secteurs d’affaires, les équipes TI, les responsables de projets et les différentes instances de gouvernance.

Le rôle nécessite une excellente capacité d’analyse et de rédaction ainsi qu'une bonne compréhension des processus de préparation et d’autorisation de projets TI. La personne recherchée doit être capable de transformer des besoins parfois complexes ou encore peu définis en dossiers structurés, complets et conformes aux exigences organisationnelles et gouvernementales.

Exigences principales

  • Diplôme universitaire de premier cycle dans un domaine pertinent : administration, analyse d’affaires, gestion de projet, santé publique ou domaine équivalent.
  • Diplôme reconnu par le MÉLS ou équivalence du MIFI.
  • Expérience pertinente en analyse d’affaires dans des projets TI.
  • Expérience concrète en collecte, analyse et clarification des besoins d’affaires.
  • Expérience en préparation et cadrage d’avant-projets TI.
  • Expérience dans la rédaction ou la préparation de dossiers d’opportunité (DO) et de dossiers d’affaires (DA).
  • Capacité à rédiger et réviser des documents de présentation et de justification de projets.
  • Expérience dans la coordination entre les équipes d’affaires et les équipes TI.
  • Excellentes capacités rédactionnelles, d’analyse, de synthèse et d’organisation.
  • Capacité à animer des rencontres et ateliers avec différentes parties prenantes.
  • Capacité à gérer plusieurs dossiers ou projets simultanément.
  • Capacité à travailler dans un environnement multidisciplinaire et à naviguer dans l’ambiguïté.
  • Leadership, autonomie et orientation vers l’amélioration continue.
  • Excellente maîtrise du français.

Atouts

  • Expérience dans un ministère, organisme gouvernemental ou organisation parapublique.
  • Expérience dans le réseau de la santé et des services sociaux (RSSS).
  • Connaissance de la LGGRI et des cadres réglementaires applicables aux projets TI gouvernementaux.
  • Expérience avec les processus de gouvernance, d’autorisation et d’investissement associés aux projets TI.
  • Expérience dans l’analyse de besoins numériques liés à des systèmes de gestion, plateformes de projets ou outils spécialisés.
  • Bonne compréhension des environnements numériques complexes.
  • Connaissance des principes de gestion et de sécurisation de l’information.
  • Un profil de développeur-analyste peut également être considéré si la personne possède une expérience concrète en analyse d’affaires.

Objectifs et livrables

  • Accompagner les demandeurs dans la définition et la structuration de leurs initiatives TI.
  • Produire et bonifier les documents d’avant-projet, notamment les idées de projet, dossiers d’opportunité (DO) et dossiers d’affaires (DA).
  • Assurer la conformité des dossiers avec les orientations stratégiques, normes et exigences réglementaires.
  • Faciliter la collaboration entre les demandeurs, les équipes TI et les instances de gouvernance.
  • Améliorer la qualité et la complétude des dossiers soumis pour approbation.
  • Contribuer à l’amélioration continue et à la simplification des processus de préparation des projets.

Responsabilités principales

  • Analyser les demandes de projets TI et clarifier les besoins des demandeurs.
  • Accompagner les secteurs d’affaires dans la formulation et la documentation de leurs besoins.
  • Rédiger, réviser et compléter les dossiers d’opportunité et dossiers d’affaires.
  • S’assurer que les gabarits et informations nécessaires au processus d’autorisation sont complets.
  • Faire le lien entre les demandeurs et les équipes TI afin d’obtenir les informations fonctionnelles et techniques requises.
  • Collecter, analyser et valider l’information auprès des différentes parties prenantes.
  • Soutenir les équipes dans la production et l’optimisation de la documentation réglementaire et gouvernementale.
  • Évaluer la conformité des initiatives avec les orientations stratégiques du client.
  • Planifier, préparer et animer les rencontres liées aux activités d’avant-projet et de planification.
  • Assurer le suivi des approbations et autorisations.
  • Maintenir une communication proactive avec les directions clientes et les équipes TI.
  • Identifier des possibilités de simplification et d’optimisation des processus.
  • Contribuer à l’amélioration continue de la gestion des demandes de projets.

You'll also contribute to evolving our brand identities, bringing fresh ideas while ensuring consistency across channels. This role is fully remote, but to keep collaboration smooth and our working hours nicely aligned, we’re looking for someone based in Europe.

You’ll be officially employed in your country of residence through our Employer of Record (EOR) partner, so you can enjoy the flexibility of remote work while being fully employed locally.

About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA builds technology products used by millions of users across Southeast Asia. As our products and systems scale, we need technical leaders who can solve difficult engineering problems and raise the engineering bar around them.

The Principal Software Engineer owns technical direction and execution for major products and systems. This is a hands-on role - you will design systems, write code, and drive critical engineering work from idea to production.

What You'll Own

  • Owning technical design and execution for major products, systems and engineering initiatives.

  • Designing scalable, reliable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Building alongside the team through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Driving architecture decisions and trade-offs across speed, scalability, reliability, cost and maintainability.

  • Turning ambiguous product problems into clear technical solutions and execution plans.

  • Raising engineering quality through stronger system design, testing, security, observability and development practices.

  • Leading technically critical initiatives and mentoring engineers across teams.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep expertise in backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Track record of technically leading major engineering projects from design through production.

  • Ability to make sound technical trade-offs, influence engineers and solve complex production problems.

Nice to have

  • Experience scaling engineering teams, systems or development practices through significant growth.

  • Experience operating across multiple products, markets or countries.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.
